reviewed_coverage.current_policy: Missing policy defaults to enforce; malformed policies are refused. Explicit off/warn remain separately governed modes.
reviewed_coverage.identity: Native writer seals author_id from the calling identity. Creator, assignee and executor conflicts are evaluated separately; no identity is synthesized.
reviewed_coverage.denial: Enforce rejects both approve and reject attempts when the native report identifies the reviewer as executor, before validation/status changes.
reviewed_coverage.legacy_removal: actor_id, author_agent_id, author and created_by are not accepted as conclusion authors. Incompatible/missing authors fail closed in every policy mode, rather than being converted or ignored.
reviewed_coverage.history: Attempting review over an incompatible conclusion leaves the record, status and validation history unchanged even when the caller commits.
reviewed_coverage.MCP: The actual tool projects reviewer_separation_required with action_required and request_independent_task_validator; fixture supplies actor/permissions, not a second identity.

limits: Card validation entry state is seeded to isolate reviewer policy; full lifecycle is separately qualified under T01.
MCP policy tests inject authenticated context and independent completion gates; do not certify credential resolution.
No frontend changes. Community regressions still active; not a claim of complete C4.
